\section{2026-10-07, 02:00: v20 at six partitions, v21 relaunched, and the collapse census\secstatus{todo}}

\pfstep{v20 is complete on four partitions and live on two} Tasks 2 and 3 of the conditioned
round finished at epoch 1{,}199 on \file{cabbi} after 21 h each; tasks 4 and 5 are at epochs
447 to 498 and tasks 6 to 11 wait under the two-task throttle, about 21 h per pair.
\cref{tab:v20-partial} is the readout at six partitions. The proteome head conditioned on the
strain's own expression sits above the unconditioned arm of the same partition at the same
epochs on 6 of 6 (by $+0.018$ to $+0.097$, mean $+0.055$), and above its permuted-expression
control on 6 of 6 (by $+0.034$ to $+0.101$, mean $+0.054$): the gain uses the strain's own
measurement. The expression head conditioned on the proteome is above the unconditioned arm
on 5 of 6 (mean $+0.031$; split seed 2 read $-0.049$ at epoch 1{,}135 and $-0.005$ at
1{,}199) and above its permuted control on 6 of 6 (mean $+0.045$, split seed 0 by $0.003$).
Both conditioned heads remain below the pre-registered per-partition ridge from the measured
other modality ($0.236$ expression, $0.214$ proteome on one split): the model uses the other
modality, and less efficiently than a linear map from it. Splits 4 and 5 are partial.

\input{../019-simb-multimodal-expression/tables/v20_partial.tex}

\pfstep{The 26 untouched v21 packs were relaunched in place} The author's decision was the
in-place swap. From 18:38 to 18:51 \file{delta_v21_inplace_swap.sh} stopped the slow runs of
every untouched pack and relaunched four fresh runs each inside the same jobs, 104 runs on
the code of pack 0. Startup took 65 minutes with 104 runs importing from \file{/work/hdd} and
materializing their splits from one LMDB over Lustre at once (pack 0 alone took 5 minutes);
training began near 19:45 at a median 38 s per plain epoch and about 44 s with the eval-mode
train pass, and at 01:26 the runs were at epochs 353 to 481. The median run ends near 10:40
on 2026-10-07 and the slowest near 15:00, against a limit near 22:00. Pack 0 finished its two
surviving runs at 1{,}199 and was canceled by hand: its watcher's \texttt{pgrep} matched its
own command line and would never have fired. The relaunched packs end with
\texttt{scancel} after the pack script returns.
\src{notes/user.Mjvolk3.torchcell.tasks.weekly.2026.41.multimodal-phenotype-retrospective.md}

\pfstep{Collapse is a one-epoch event, frequent, arm-dependent, and rarely reversed}
\cref{tab:collapse-census} counts every dead stretch of the two small-trunk rounds. The
spread ratio falls from 0.1 to 0.3 to below 0.01 between consecutive epochs, and the
validation loss is equal or lower afterwards, so the per-gene-mean predictor is a stable
basin rather than a divergence. At the 01:50 read, of 54 stretches of 50 epochs or more, 10
later returned to a spread of 0.05, and of the 29 of 100 or more, 3 (the table is regenerated
on the finished rounds; \cref{sec:round-complete} gives the final counts). Gradient clipping
(threshold 10) never fired in any run; the per-epoch gradient norm at the collapse epoch is a
median 1.14 times the mean of the 50 epochs before (quartiles 0.96 to 1.48, 5 of 54 at 2 or more), so a
gradient spike is NOT the general trigger, which corrects the reading of three cases on the
evening of 2026-10-06. Onsets concentrate between epochs 150 and 350, right after launch. By
arm, on the relaunched v21 round at epochs 491 to 663: Hadamard 8 of 12 collapsed, no
dropout 5, null sink 5, stack 4, rank-64 basis 3, reference 1 of 8, and the mask schedule,
the propagation arm and the proteome 0 of 12 each. Fourteen collapsed or never-launched runs
of the pre-swap round were stopped by hand on 2026-10-06; the relaunched round's collapsed
runs are still running. Hypothesis (untested): the Hadamard and no-dropout arms collapse
because their per-gene product leaves the perturbation path without a bounded gate; the null
sink's 5 of 12 argues against the gate being sufficient.

\pfstep{The twelve-seed baselines on the both-label store} IGB job 2423302 ran the ridge and
nearest-neighbor baselines on the strains carrying both labels, the store v21 and v22 train
on, over all twelve split seeds (\cref{tab:baselines-both-label}). On expression the
nearest-neighbor average on ProtT5 reaches $0.110 \pm 0.017$ validation and $0.090 \pm 0.027$
test; on the proteome $0.065 \pm 0.013$ and $0.040 \pm 0.024$. Every v22 window score
($0.062$ to $0.075$) and every v21 trailing score read so far sit below the expression
baselines on this store. The same job's expression-label run on the whole fig3\_proteome
store had overwritten the committed protein-abundance seeds 0 to 3 in
\file{baselines_split_fig3_proteome_full/}; those were restored from the repository, the
expression files moved to \file{baselines_split_fig3_proteome_expression_log2_ratio_full/},
and the writer now keys a non-default label into the directory name.
